caseName: Connecticut State Board of Parole v. Bey
caseNameFull: Connecticut State Board of Parole v. Bey

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States District Court for the District of Connecticut with directions to dismiss as moot. United States v. Munsingwear, 340 U. S. 36.
